name: @vssaros/dsh-pele
description: VsSaros pele module for DeepSeek Harness: the single Mermaid → SVG renderer for the whole product (pele 1.6.0, MIT, vendored as assets/pele.global.js). Ships a `render_diagram` tool (validate / measure / optionally return SVG) for dsh, and the same bundle is loaded in-process by the IDE renderer (chat cards, ```mermaid fences, knowledge-base notes, .mermaid file preview) — replacing the former hidden-webview + mermaid 12 pipeline. Theme presets live in assets/pele-theme.json (read by both sides).
